_note: THE SFX-SWEETENING LIBRARY (2026-07-14, CLAUDE.md rule 82 — Julian: 'go with those two things you flagged'). Read by engine/cb_post.py's sweetening step, via the engine/config -> shows/crystal-bears/canon symlink (config/sfx_library.json). Scoped EXACTLY to the four signature one-shots this show's own doctrine already names (CRYSTAL_BEARS_STUDIO_BIBLE.md, CLAUDE.md rule 57/82) — deliberately not expanded to every archetype's own plausible sound, per the same doctrine's own 'weak COMEDY hits' framing (dramatic/serious beats are excluded on purpose). 'file' is relative to this file's own directory (shows/crystal-bears/canon/) — e.g. 'sfx/fwip.mp3' resolves to shows/crystal-bears/canon/sfx/fwip.mp3. NONE of the four files exist yet — this manifest is the SCAFFOLDING (cb_post.py's lookup gracefully skips any cue whose file is absent, exactly like the existing music/ambience convention); dropping a real recorded/licensed .mp3 into shows/crystal-bears/canon/sfx/ at the named path is the only remaining step to activate a cue. 'archetypes' lists which of cb_seedance.PHYSICAL_ARCHETYPES this cue is wired to via cb_post.ARCHETYPE_TO_SFX_CUE — kept here too so a human reading this manifest doesn't have to cross-reference the Python source to understand why a given cue exists.

FWIP.description: A leaf-impact snap-and-bounce — a springy WHAP as a character slams into a leaf and rebounds. The show's own signature crash sound.

THUP.description: A soft, rubbery bounce/tumble impact — the sound of a comic tumble bouncing off something soft, escalating in pitch across repeats (per 1.B3's own authored 'THUP, THUP, THUP').

POLLEN_PUFF.description: A soft flower WHOOMP followed immediately by a light pollen-puff release — the sound of a flower compressing under contact and springing back. NOTE (2026-07-14 correction): earlier doctrine text (CLAUDE.md, CRYSTAL_BEARS_STUDIO_BIBLE.md) named this cue 'pollen poof' — every real occurrence in the actual authored beat data says 'pollen puff' (7+ instances, zero instances of 'poof'); this manifest keys on the real, consistently-used term.

POP.description: A bright, triumphant pop — the finisher sound for a character popping upright out of a stuck/tumbled position, turning a mishap into a proud little victory.
